components.name: Step by step working animator
components.valueInterface: data.lesson = {state: {preset: native preset key, ...overrides of that preset's data fields}, phase: native step index, motion?: {from,to,durationMs}, title?}. Records with concealAnswers draw the engine's own Challenge view for the lesson preset.
components.limitations: Concealed view is the native Challenge view for the lesson preset. Working lines, operations and focus captions are lesson data checked for equivalence line by line. Teacher narration is the native preset text, which is reused unchanged, so override presets should keep the same kind of method. Common to all engines: at 390 px the phone-label floor enlarges small SVG labels (up to 2.4x) so they reach 11 px. A drag in progress is cancelled when the 760 px breakpoint is crossed, because the redraw replays the last draw; completed pupil state is kept.
